title: Tool schema advertises competitions not present in the provided data
evidence: lib/brazilian_soccer_mcp/competition.ex:12-17 defines brasileirao_b/brasileirao_c labels and tools.ex:24-25 lists them in the `competition` enum, but data_loader.ex only ever assigns brasileirao, copa_do_brasil and libertadores keys — Série B/C datasets are not among the provided CSVs.
suggestion: Harmless (forward-looking for optional API sources); could note in the tool description that B/C return empty with the bundled data.
